scientific_integrity: Proof invokes Feng–Nukala Theorem 18 for homology concentration and recomputes characters by exact finite signed Lefschetz sums and character orthogonality; packaged verifier reproduces each computation.
scientific_limitations: Finite 30-vertex rational S6 x C2 homology modules; the nonequivariant wedge type is previously known. No integral module classification or family-wide equivariant extension. Potential unindexed equivalent result; independent mathematical validation not performed.
title: Complement-refined symmetric-group homology of the six-coordinate two-rank Rips space
